001package com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners;
002
003import java.util.List;
004
005import java.awt.Color;
006
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.Industry;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.Industry.IndustryTooltipMode;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.ui.TooltipMakerAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
011
012public interface IndustryOptionProvider {
013
014        public class IndustryOptionData {
015                public String text;
016                public Color color;
017                public boolean enabled = true;
018                public Object id;
019                public Industry ind;
020                public IndustryOptionProvider provider;
021                
022                
023                public IndustryOptionData(String text, Object id, Industry ind, IndustryOptionProvider provider) {
024                        this.text = text;
025                        this.id = id;
026                        this.ind = ind;
027                        this.provider = provider;
028                        
029                        if (ind.getMarket() != null) {
030                                color = ind.getMarket().getFaction().getBaseUIColor();
031                        } else {
032                                color = Misc.getBasePlayerColor();
033                        }
034                }
035        }
036        
037        public List<IndustryOptionData> getIndustryOptions(Industry ind);
038        public void createTooltip(IndustryOptionData opt, TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float width);
039        
040        public void optionSelected(IndustryOptionData opt, DialogCreatorUI ui);
041        public void addToIndustryTooltip(Industry ind, IndustryTooltipMode mode, TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float width, boolean expanded);
042        default public void addToIndustryTooltipIfIndustryNotPresent(Industry ind, IndustryTooltipMode mode, TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, float width, boolean expanded) {};
043}
